laws.title: 0.03% BAC Driving Limit
laws.subtitle: Japan's strict drink-driving threshold applies across Kanagawa
laws.fullDescription: Under the Road Traffic Act (道路交通法), driving with a BAC of 0.03% or above is a criminal offence. Kanagawa Police enforce this at checkpoints on the Tomei Expressway and Route 1 Tokaido. Even a single standard drink can push an average person over the limit.
laws.penalty: Up to 3 years imprisonment or ¥500,000 fine; licence suspension for first offence
exceptions: Commercial drivers are held to a zero-tolerance standard

quiz.q: What is Japan's BAC limit for driving, enforced in Kanagawa?
quiz.explanation: Japan's Road Traffic Act sets the BAC limit at 0.03%, among the strictest in the world.

laws.title: Yokohama Noise Control Ordinance
laws.subtitle: Strict decibel limits in Japan's second-largest city
laws.fullDescription: Yokohama City's Noise Control Ordinance sets maximum noise levels for construction, factories, and entertainment venues. Residential areas may not be subjected to more than 60 dB(A) during day hours (08:00–19:00) or 45 dB(A) at night. Construction within 50 metres of a school or hospital requires advance notification and must stop by 19:00.
laws.penalty: Fines up to ¥500,000; stop-work orders for persistent construction violations
exceptions: Emergency public works approved by the city may operate outside standard hours

quiz.q: What is the nighttime noise limit in Yokohama residential areas?
quiz.explanation: Yokohama's ordinance limits nighttime noise in residential zones to 45 dB(A).

laws.title: Yokohama Port Industrial Emissions Standards
laws.subtitle: Strict air quality rules govern Japan's busiest port
laws.fullDescription: Yokohama enforces strict industrial emissions standards under the Air Pollution Control Act and Kanagawa Prefecture's enhanced ordinance. Port factories must install continuous emissions monitoring and report monthly. Kanagawa's history of severe industrial pollution drove some of Japan's earliest environmental laws.
laws.penalty: Up to ¥3,000,000 fine or 1 year imprisonment for exceeding emissions standards
exceptions: Small-scale workshops below emission thresholds use simplified self-reporting

quiz.q: What must Yokohama Port factories install under Kanagawa's environmental rules?
quiz.explanation: Yokohama Port industrial facilities must install continuous emissions monitoring and report monthly.

laws.title: Kamakura Great Buddha Protection Zone
laws.subtitle: Building and excavation restrictions around the national treasure
laws.fullDescription: The Kamakura Great Buddha (鎌倉大仏, Kotoku-in), a National Treasure, sits within a protected archaeological zone. Construction and excavation within 200 metres require approval from the Agency for Cultural Affairs. High-rise development altering the scenic backdrop is prohibited under Kamakura's landscape plan.
laws.penalty: Up to ¥500,000 fine or 5 years imprisonment for damaging designated national treasures
exceptions: Approved conservation works by certified heritage bodies are exempt

quiz.q: How far from the Kamakura Great Buddha is construction restricted?
quiz.explanation: Construction and excavation within 200 metres of the Great Buddha require Agency for Cultural Affairs approval.

laws.title: Tokaido Shinkansen Passenger Conduct Rules
laws.subtitle: JR Central enforces strict behaviour rules on the high-speed line
laws.fullDescription: The Tokaido Shinkansen, stopping at Shin-Yokohama, is governed by JR Central's conduct rules and the Railway Business Act. Passengers must not obstruct doors, must use mobile phones silently in car 7 (quiet car on Hikari), and should avoid strong-smelling food in the cabin.
laws.penalty: Removal from train by staff; fines for obstructing railway operations up to ¥1,000,000
exceptions: Green Car passengers may receive food service trays

quiz.q: What is the quiet car rule on Tokaido Shinkansen Hikari services?
options: Mobile phone calls banned in car 7
quiz.explanation: On Hikari Shinkansen services, car 7 is a quiet car where mobile phone calls are prohibited.

laws.title: Yokohama Rental Housing Discrimination Prohibition
laws.subtitle: Landlords may not refuse foreigners, elderly, or disabled tenants without cause
laws.fullDescription: Yokohama City's housing guidelines reinforce the national Housing Accommodation Act. Landlords receiving city subsidies must not refuse tenants on grounds of nationality, age, or disability. The city operates a landlord mediation service, and documented discrimination may be reported to Kanagawa Prefecture.
laws.penalty: Loss of city subsidy eligibility; public naming for persistent discrimination
exceptions: Shared housing with landlord on premises may impose certain house rules

quiz.q: What may Yokohama landlords lose if they discriminate in housing?
quiz.explanation: Landlords receiving city subsidies risk losing that eligibility if they discriminate on protected grounds.

laws.title: Yokohama Gang Violence Exclusion Ordinance
laws.subtitle: Port city's organised crime laws are among Japan's strictest
laws.fullDescription: Kanagawa's Violent Crime Group Exclusion Ordinance covers the entire prefecture. Businesses must include anti-organised crime clauses in contracts and must report extortion attempts to police within 30 days. Failure to report may result in liability alongside the extorting party.
laws.penalty: Fines for businesses that pay extortion without reporting; up to 1 year imprisonment for associated parties
exceptions: Businesses that report immediately and cooperate with police are protected from prosecution

quiz.q: How many days do Kanagawa businesses have to report extortion to police?
quiz.explanation: Kanagawa businesses must report extortion attempts to police within 30 days of the incident.

laws.title: Yokohama Fish Market Seafood Traceability
laws.subtitle: Sellers must document the origin of all seafood products
laws.fullDescription: Under the Food Labelling Act and Kanagawa's supplementary guidelines, seafood sold at Yokohama's Honmoku Wharf Market must carry country-of-origin labelling and, for wild-caught species, the catch area. Sellers lacking origin documentation face sales suspension.
laws.penalty: Sales suspension; fines up to ¥1,000,000 for repeat mislabelling
exceptions: Pre-packaged products from certified processors with printed labels are exempt from additional documentation

quiz.q: What must wild-caught seafood labels include at Yokohama markets?
options: Country of origin and catch area
quiz.explanation: Wild-caught seafood must carry country-of-origin labelling and the catch area.

laws.title: Yokohama International School Accreditation
laws.subtitle: Foreign curriculum schools must meet prefecture registration standards
laws.fullDescription: Kanagawa's international schools may operate as miscellaneous schools (各種学校) upon prefecture approval under the School Education Act. They must meet minimum safety, staffing, and curriculum disclosure standards. Schools on US military bases operate under SOFA and are exempt from prefecture oversight.
laws.penalty: Fines up to ¥300,000; closure order for operating without registration
exceptions: Military base and diplomatic mission schools operate under their own jurisdictions

quiz.q: Under which legal category do international schools typically operate in Kanagawa?
quiz.explanation: International schools in Kanagawa are typically registered as miscellaneous schools under the School Education Act.

laws.title: US Naval Base Yokosuka Access Rules
laws.subtitle: Civilians require military authorisation to enter SOFA-governed facilities
laws.fullDescription: Yokosuka Naval Base, home of the US 7th Fleet, operates under the Japan-US Status of Forces Agreement (SOFA). Japanese nationals and non-US foreign nationals require prior authorisation to enter. Japanese authorities have limited jurisdiction over crimes within the base perimeter.
laws.penalty: Trespassing: arrest by US military police and/or Japanese police; deportation for non-residents
exceptions: Invited guests and contractors with valid passes may enter designated areas
laws.sourceLabel: Japan Ministry of Foreign Affairs — SOFA

quiz.q: What agreement governs US military bases in Kanagawa?
quiz.explanation: US bases in Japan operate under the Status of Forces Agreement (SOFA), which takes precedence over local ordinances.

laws.title: Sagami Bay Marine Protected Area
laws.subtitle: Restrictions on fishing and anchoring in designated habitat zones
laws.fullDescription: Parts of Sagami Bay are designated Nature Conservation Areas, protecting diverse ecosystems including sea turtle nesting beaches at Yuigahama. Commercial fishing vessels must not anchor within marked zones and must respect seasonal species restrictions. Divers removing marine life face criminal penalties.
laws.penalty: Up to ¥500,000 fine for unauthorised fishing or anchoring in protected zones
exceptions: Licensed scientific research vessels with prefectural permits may operate in protected zones

quiz.q: What is notably protected on Yuigahama beach in Kanagawa?
quiz.explanation: Yuigahama beach has sea turtle nesting sites protected under Kanagawa's Nature Conservation Area designations.

laws.title: Kanagawa Multicultural Coexistence Ordinance
laws.subtitle: Prefecture promotes rights of foreign residents
laws.fullDescription: Kanagawa's Basic Policy on Multicultural Coexistence ensures foreign residents have equal access to prefecture services with language support in at least English, Chinese, Korean, Portuguese, and Spanish. The policy was pioneered due to large Brazilian and Korean communities.
laws.penalty: No specific penalty; violations reported to the prefecture ombudsman
exceptions: Security-sensitive services may be restricted to Japanese nationals

quiz.q: Which language communities prompted Kanagawa's multicultural policy?
quiz.explanation: Kanagawa's multicultural policy was shaped particularly by its large Brazilian and Korean resident communities.

laws.title: Kanagawa Prefecture Tobacco Tax
laws.subtitle: Prefecture-level tobacco tax applies on top of national rates
laws.fullDescription: Kanagawa levies a prefectural tobacco tax on manufacturers and importers. Combined national, prefectural, and municipal tobacco tax accounts for over 60% of the retail price of cigarettes. Selling untaxed tobacco products is a criminal offence.
laws.penalty: Up to ¥1,000,000 fine or 3 years imprisonment for selling untaxed tobacco
exceptions: Tobacco sold in duty-free shops to outbound international travellers is exempt

quiz.q: What percentage of a cigarette's retail price in Kanagawa consists of combined tobacco taxes?
quiz.explanation: Combined national, prefectural, and municipal tobacco taxes account for over 60% of cigarette retail prices in Kanagawa.

laws.title: Kanagawa Indoor Smoking Restrictions
laws.subtitle: Japan's first prefecture to ban indoor smoking in public places
laws.fullDescription: Kanagawa was Japan's first prefecture to enact an indoor public places smoking ban with its Passive Smoking Prevention Ordinance in 2009 — a decade before the national law. Smoking is prohibited inside restaurants, bars, hotels, and entertainment venues open to the public.
laws.penalty: Fines up to ¥50,000 for venue operators who fail to enforce the smoking ban
exceptions: Designated smoking rooms with sealed ventilation systems are permitted

quiz.q: When did Kanagawa introduce Japan's first indoor public places smoking ban?
quiz.explanation: Kanagawa enacted Japan's first indoor smoking ban ordinance in 2009, a decade before the national law.

laws.title: Tsunami Evacuation Zones — Kanagawa Coastline
laws.subtitle: Strict building and evacuation rules in Sagami Bay tsunami risk areas
laws.fullDescription: Following 2011 Tōhoku, Kanagawa revised tsunami hazard maps. Coastal areas of Kamakura, Fujisawa, and Hiratsuka are classified as Tsunami Hazard Zones. New residential construction in highest-risk zones requires elevated foundations or tsunami-resistant certification. Evacuation routes must be posted along the coast.
laws.penalty: Building permit refusal for non-compliant coastal construction; fines for removing evacuation signage
exceptions: Industrial port facilities with tsunami impact assessments may use alternative protective measures

quiz.q: Which coastal Kanagawa cities have Tsunami Hazard Zone designations?
quiz.explanation: Kamakura, Fujisawa, and Hiratsuka are among the Kanagawa coastal cities with Tsunami Hazard Zone designations.

laws.title: Kawasaki Heavy Industry Safety Regulations
laws.subtitle: Kanagawa's industrial corridor faces enhanced worker safety oversight
laws.fullDescription: Kawasaki City, one of Japan's foremost heavy industry centres, has enhanced industrial safety inspections. Chemical plants and steel works must have on-site safety supervisors at all times. Near-miss incidents must be reported within 24 hours, and fatal accidents trigger mandatory prefecture-level investigation.
laws.penalty: Up to ¥3,000,000 fine; work suspension; criminal prosecution for managerial negligence causing death
exceptions: Administrative offices of factories use standard safety rules

quiz.q: Within how many hours must near-miss incidents be reported in Kawasaki industrial facilities?
quiz.explanation: Near-miss incidents in Kawasaki's industrial facilities must be reported within 24 hours.

laws.title: Shonan Beach Conduct Rules
laws.subtitle: Japan's most famous surf beach has strict seasonal rules
laws.fullDescription: Shonan Beach, Japan's surf capital, has seasonal ordinances (June–September) prohibiting glass containers, open fires outside BBQ areas, and alcohol in carparks. Surfers must use designated surfing areas marked by buoys, separated from swimmer zones.
laws.penalty: Fines ¥5,000–¥20,000 for glass container violations; civil liability for surfing zone collisions
exceptions: Lifeguard-supervised swimming areas may expand or contract seasonally

quiz.q: What is prohibited at Shonan Beach under seasonal rules?
options: Glass containers and fires outside BBQ zones
quiz.explanation: Glass containers and open fires outside designated BBQ areas are prohibited at Shonan Beach during the summer season.

laws.title: Kanagawa Farmland Preservation Ordinance
laws.subtitle: Urban sprawl restrictions protect remaining agricultural land
laws.fullDescription: Kanagawa has among Japan's highest land values, creating pressure to convert farmland. Converting registered agricultural land requires approval from the Kanagawa Agricultural Committee. Urban farming plots in Yokohama and Kawasaki must maintain active cultivation to retain reduced tax treatment.
laws.penalty: Back-payment of full property taxes if farmland is illegally developed; fines up to ¥1,000,000
exceptions: Publicly-planned infrastructure projects may override farmland protection with compensation

quiz.q: What must urban farming plots in Yokohama do to retain reduced tax treatment?
options: Open to the public twice yearly
quiz.explanation: Urban farming plots in Yokohama must maintain active cultivation to qualify for reduced agricultural tax rates.

laws.title: Yokohama Chinatown Vendor Conduct Rules
laws.subtitle: Japan's largest Chinatown has specific trading ordinances
laws.fullDescription: Yokohama's Chinatown (中華街), Japan's largest with over 600 businesses, operates under city ordinances. Hawking customers in a manner deemed threatening or obstructive is prohibited under Kanagawa's Nuisance Prevention Ordinance. Signage must comply with city bilingual labelling requirements.
laws.penalty: Warning from city; ¥10,000–¥50,000 fine for aggressive street hawking
exceptions: Traditional restaurant greeting at entrance (not physically blocking passage) is permitted

quiz.q: What is Japan's largest Chinatown?
quiz.explanation: Yokohama's Chinatown is Japan's largest, with over 600 shops and restaurants.

laws.title: Yokohama Minato Mirai Height Restrictions
laws.subtitle: Waterfront skyline managed by strict zoning height limits
laws.fullDescription: Yokohama's Minato Mirai 21 waterfront district has controlled building heights under Urban Planning Law designations. Maximum heights in sub-zones range from 120m to 296m (the Landmark Tower). New towers must undergo wind-impact and shadow assessments. The Yokohama City Design Council reviews all major development proposals.
laws.penalty: Building permits refused for non-compliant designs; mandatory redesign required
exceptions: Major public infrastructure may negotiate individual height waivers

quiz.q: What is the maximum height in the core Minato Mirai zone, marked by the Landmark Tower?
quiz.explanation: The Yokohama Landmark Tower at 296m marks the maximum height designation in the core Minato Mirai zone.

laws.title: Yokohama Consumer Cooperative Fairness Rules
laws.subtitle: Co-op retailers must provide clear pricing and membership terms
laws.fullDescription: Kanagawa has a high concentration of consumer cooperatives (生活協同組合). Under the Consumer Cooperative Societies Act, co-ops must provide itemised breakdowns of membership fees and dividend calculations. Annual audits are required for co-ops with assets over ¥3 billion.
laws.penalty: Prefecture-imposed management improvement orders; fines up to ¥2,000,000 for misleading membership practices
exceptions: Small community co-ops under ¥100M in assets use simplified reporting

quiz.q: What annual requirement applies to Kanagawa consumer co-ops with assets over ¥3 billion?
quiz.explanation: Consumer co-ops in Kanagawa with assets exceeding ¥3 billion must undergo annual audits.

laws.title: Kanagawa Human Rights Counselling Service
laws.subtitle: Prefecture provides free legal aid for discrimination complaints
laws.fullDescription: Kanagawa operates a Human Rights Counselling Centre providing free legal advice and mediation in multiple languages. Housing discrimination, workplace harassment, and ethnic discrimination are the most common complaints handled.
laws.penalty: No direct penalty mechanism; referrals to police or courts for actionable violations
exceptions: Complaints involving criminal conduct are referred directly to Kanagawa Prefectural Police

quiz.q: What are the most common complaint types at Kanagawa's Human Rights Counselling Centre?
options: Housing discrimination, workplace harassment, ethnic discrimination
quiz.explanation: Housing discrimination, workplace harassment, and ethnic discrimination are the most common complaint types.

laws.title: Kanagawa Mass Vaccination Programme Management
laws.subtitle: Prefecture coordinates large-scale public health immunisation drives
laws.fullDescription: Kanagawa, Japan's most populous prefecture, coordinates vaccination programmes with Yokohama, Kawasaki, and Sagamihara cities under the Immunization Act. During outbreaks, the Governor may invoke emergency vaccination orders. Wilful non-compliance may result in exclusion from public venues during epidemic emergencies.
laws.penalty: Exclusion from public facilities during epidemic emergency for unvaccinated non-exempt individuals
exceptions: Medical exemptions granted by certified physicians are accepted

quiz.q: Which three cities does Kanagawa coordinate vaccination programmes with?
quiz.explanation: Kanagawa coordinates mass vaccination with Yokohama, Kawasaki, and Sagamihara.

laws.title: Yokohama Port Speed Limits for Vessels
laws.subtitle: Ships must observe strict speed limits inside the harbour
laws.fullDescription: Under the Port and Harbour Act, vessels navigating within Yokohama Outer Port must not exceed 5 knots within 300 metres of piers and 3 knots in congested inner berth areas. The Port Authority monitors speed and may suspend berthing rights for violations.
laws.penalty: Fines up to ¥500,000; temporary suspension of berthing rights
exceptions: Coast guard and emergency response vessels are exempt

quiz.q: What is the speed limit for vessels within 300 metres of Yokohama Port piers?
quiz.explanation: Vessels must not exceed 5 knots within 300 metres of Yokohama Port piers.

laws.title: Odawara Castle Preservation Zone
laws.subtitle: Development controls protect the restored Sengoku-era castle
laws.fullDescription: Odawara Castle (小田原城), the Hojo clan's stronghold, is a designated Historic Site. A 200-metre preservation zone prohibits construction over 10 metres in height. Commercial activities within the inner bailey require city council approval.
laws.penalty: Fines up to ¥500,000 for illegal construction in the preservation zone
exceptions: Approved restoration and archaeological research by designated institutions are permitted

quiz.q: Which feudal clan historically held Odawara Castle?
quiz.explanation: Odawara Castle was the stronghold of the Hojo clan.

laws.title: Kawasaki Pollution Compensation Scheme
laws.subtitle: Japan's pioneering industrial pollution compensation still operates
laws.fullDescription: Kawasaki was the site of severe post-war industrial pollution. Kanagawa's compensation scheme provides medical fee assistance to residents with certified pollution-related respiratory conditions. New industrial facilities near residential areas must undergo cumulative air quality impact assessments.
laws.penalty: Fines and shutdown orders for facilities exceeding emissions limits in residential-adjacent zones
exceptions: Pre-existing facilities have transition period compliance schedules

quiz.q: What does Kawasaki's Pollution Compensation Scheme provide?
options: Medical fee assistance for pollution-related respiratory conditions
quiz.explanation: Kawasaki's scheme provides medical fee assistance for residents with certified pollution-related respiratory conditions.

laws.title: Yokohama Night-Time Economic Zone Rules
laws.subtitle: Late-night businesses in Noge and Kannai must follow extended trading rules
laws.fullDescription: Yokohama's entertainment districts operate under the Act on Control and Improvement of Amusement Business (風営法). Nightclubs and hostess bars must hold licences and may not admit minors after 18:00. Police may enter without warrant for compliance checks. Venues near Chinatown have noise curfews after 01:00.
laws.penalty: Licence suspension for admitting minors; fines up to ¥2,000,000
exceptions: Live music venues under 100 capacity may operate under simplified registration
laws.sourceLabel: Kanagawa Prefectural Police Wind Business Division

quiz.q: After what time may Yokohama nightclubs not admit minors?
quiz.explanation: Yokohama nightclubs under the Amusement Business Act must not admit minors after 18:00.

laws.title: Mt. Hakone Volcanic Alert System
laws.subtitle: Kanagawa enforces evacuation zones around Hakone's active volcano
laws.fullDescription: Mt. Hakone is an active volcano monitored by JMA. Kanagawa enforces a tiered volcanic alert system. At Alert Level 3 (Entry Restriction), summit access is prohibited and enforced by police. At Level 4, Hakone Town must begin resident evacuation. The 2015 eruption demonstrated the need for rapid enforcement.
laws.penalty: Fines or detention for entering restricted volcanic zones; civil liability for rescue costs
exceptions: JMA and approved university scientists may enter with protective equipment and authorisation

quiz.q: At what volcanic alert level is access to Hakone's summit area prohibited?
quiz.explanation: Hakone Alert Level 3 (Entry Restriction) prohibits public access to the summit area.

laws.title: Owakudani Black Eggs — Vendor Regulation
laws.subtitle: Volcanic hot spring eggs must meet food safety standards
laws.fullDescription: The famous black eggs (黒たまご) cooked in Hakone's volcanic springs are a major tourist product. Under Kanagawa's Food Sanitation Ordinance, vendors must maintain minimum storage temperatures and use-by labels. Vendors may not claim therapeutic health benefits that are not scientifically substantiated.
laws.penalty: Licence suspension for food safety failures; fines up to ¥500,000 for false health claims
exceptions: Traditional folk claims printed as cultural tourism information (not health claims) may be permissible

quiz.q: Why may Owakudani black egg production be suspended during volcanic alerts?
options: Egg quality declines at high alert levels
Safety order suspending access to volcanic vent cooking areas
quiz.explanation: Prefecture safety orders can suspend access to the volcanic vent areas used to cook the famous black eggs.

laws.title: Kanagawa Foreign Worker Housing Support Rules
laws.subtitle: Employers bringing foreign workers must meet housing standards
laws.fullDescription: Kanagawa, a major destination for overseas Technical Intern Trainees, enforces employer-provided housing standards through the Kanagawa Labour Bureau and OTIT. Employer housing must meet minimum floor space (4.5 tatami per person), sanitation, and heating standards. Employers may not deduct excessive amounts for housing.
laws.penalty: Programme suspension; employer banned from accepting new trainees for up to 5 years
exceptions: Dormitory-style accommodation is permitted if individual space minimums are met per occupant

quiz.q: What is the minimum floor space per person for foreign worker housing in Kanagawa?
quiz.explanation: Employer-provided housing for foreign workers must provide a minimum of 4.5 tatami per person.

laws.title: Hakone Open-Air Museum Safety Rules
laws.subtitle: Outdoor sculpture parks must meet visitor safety and preservation standards
laws.fullDescription: The Hakone Open-Air Museum (箱根彫刻の森美術館), Japan's first open-air museum (1969), operates under Ministry of Education registration and local tourism regulations. Visitors may not touch sculptures unless signage permits, and commercial photography requires written permission. Display conditions for loaned artworks are contractually binding.
laws.penalty: Civil liability for restoration costs for visitors damaging sculptures
exceptions: Hands-on interactive sculptures designated as tactile exhibits are exempt from no-touch rules

quiz.q: What was historically notable about the Hakone Open-Air Museum?
options: It was Japan's first open-air museum
It was designed by a famous architect
It was the first museum in Kanagawa
quiz.explanation: The Hakone Open-Air Museum was Japan's first open-air museum, established in 1969.

laws.title: Yokohama Municipal Bond Transparency
laws.subtitle: Japan's largest municipal bond issuer faces strict disclosure rules
laws.fullDescription: Yokohama City is Japan's largest municipal bond issuer. Under the Local Finance Act and Securities Exchange Act, it must publish annual financial statements and bond prospectuses disclosing all major liabilities. Deliberate non-disclosure may expose city officials to criminal liability.
laws.penalty: Criminal prosecution for officials knowingly misrepresenting municipal finances; bond issue suspension
exceptions: Information classified for national security may be withheld

quiz.q: What distinction does Yokohama City hold in Japan's municipal finance market?
options: First city to issue green bonds
quiz.explanation: Yokohama City is Japan's largest municipal bond issuer.

laws.title: Yokohama Municipal Subway Fare Evasion Rules
laws.subtitle: Strict gate system and surveillance for fare compliance
laws.fullDescription: The Yokohama Municipal Subway enforces fare payment through automatic gates. Fare evasion is a civil and criminal offence. Persistent evaders face unpaid fares plus a penalty charge of up to 3 times the fare. IC card users passing through exit gates without sufficient balance cannot exit until balance is topped up.
laws.penalty: Civil claim for unpaid fares plus 3× penalty surcharge; criminal prosecution for deliberate systematic evasion
exceptions: Passengers delayed by operational failure receive free supplementary ride vouchers

quiz.q: What penalty surcharge can persistent fare evaders face on Yokohama Municipal Subway?
quiz.explanation: Persistent fare evaders face unpaid fares plus a 3× penalty surcharge.

laws.title: Yokohama Port Drug Interdiction Laws
laws.subtitle: Major port enforces strict drug import/export detection
laws.fullDescription: Yokohama Customs and Kanagawa Prefectural Police collaborate on drug interdiction at Yokohama Port. Container scanning and drug-detection dogs operate on all high-risk cargo. Japan's drug penalties are among the strictest in the developed world — importing even small amounts of cannabis or methamphetamine can carry potential life imprisonment.
laws.penalty: Up to life imprisonment for large-scale drug importation; minimum 1 year for any commercial drug import
exceptions: Licensed pharmaceutical manufacturers may import restricted substances with Ministry of Health approval

quiz.q: What controls drug importation through Yokohama Port?
options: Yokohama Customs and Kanagawa Prefectural Police collaborating
quiz.explanation: Yokohama Port's drug interdiction is a collaboration between Yokohama Customs and Kanagawa Prefectural Police.

laws.title: Kanagawa Residence Card Registration Rules
laws.subtitle: Foreign nationals must update residence registration within 14 days
laws.fullDescription: Foreign nationals residing in Kanagawa for more than 3 months must register their address at the local ward or city office within 14 days of arriving. They must carry their Residence Card at all times. Kanagawa's Yokohama Immigration Bureau handles all status changes.
laws.penalty: Up to ¥200,000 fine for failure to register; deportation in serious cases
exceptions: Short-stay tourists and diplomatic personnel use separate registration processes

quiz.q: How many days do foreign nationals have to register their address in Kanagawa?
quiz.explanation: Foreign nationals staying over 3 months must register within 14 days of arriving.

laws.title: Yokohama Museum of Art Loan Conditions
laws.subtitle: International art loans follow strict conservation and insurance rules
laws.fullDescription: Yokohama Museum of Art operates under national museum law and international loan agreements. Loaned artworks valued over ¥10,000,000 must carry Government Indemnity insurance. Display conditions including temperature (18–22°C), humidity (45–55% RH), and lighting (max 50 lux for watercolours) are contractually binding.
laws.penalty: Civil liability to lending institution for damage; potential exclusion from future international loan programmes
exceptions: Permanent collection works displayed at museum's discretion do not require indemnity insurance

quiz.q: What maximum lux level must Yokohama Museum maintain for watercolour loans?
quiz.explanation: Watercolour works on loan must be displayed at no more than 50 lux to prevent light damage.

laws.title: Kanagawa Swimming Pool Hygiene Standards
laws.subtitle: Public and hotel pools must meet residual chlorine standards
laws.fullDescription: Under Kanagawa's building sanitation guidance, public pools must maintain residual free chlorine between 0.4 and 1.0 mg/L and turbidity below 0.5 degrees. Pools must be tested at minimum three times per day. Pools used by more than 50 persons daily must appoint a certified pool sanitation manager.
laws.penalty: Closure orders for out-of-standard pool water; fines up to ¥300,000
exceptions: Natural outdoor swimming areas (sea or river) are managed under separate beach safety rules

quiz.q: How often must public pool water be tested during operating hours in Kanagawa?
quiz.explanation: Kanagawa requires public pools to test water quality at minimum three times per day.

laws.title: Miura Peninsula Vegetable Brand Protection
laws.subtitle: Miura daikon and watermelon carry prefecture certification marks
laws.fullDescription: The Miura Peninsula is famous for Miura daikon (三浦大根) and watermelons. Kanagawa Prefecture Agricultural Co-operative certifies produce under JA Kanagawa Miura brand standards. Producers outside the approved growing area may not use the Miura brand name.
laws.penalty: Trademark infringement proceedings; up to ¥1,000,000 in fines for false brand use
exceptions: Home gardening for personal use is not subject to brand certification

quiz.q: What famous vegetable is the Miura Peninsula known for?
quiz.explanation: The Miura Peninsula is famous for Miura daikon (giant radish) and watermelons.

laws.title: Yokohama City Partnership Certification
laws.subtitle: Yokohama recognises same-sex and unmarried partnerships
laws.fullDescription: Since 2021, Yokohama City issues Partnership Certification to same-sex and other unmarried couples. Certificate holders may share city-managed public housing, access joint medical decisions at city hospitals, and be treated as partners for city administrative purposes.
laws.penalty: False declarations may result in certificate revocation and administrative penalties
exceptions: National-law marriage rights are unchanged; the certificate has no family registry (戸籍) effect

quiz.q: When did Yokohama City introduce its partnership certification scheme?
quiz.explanation: Yokohama City launched its partnership certification scheme in 2021.

laws.title: Yokohama Online Consumer Fraud Prevention
laws.subtitle: City operates active SNS-monitoring scam alert service
laws.fullDescription: Yokohama City Consumer Affairs Centre monitors social media for scam advertisements targeting Kanagawa residents. Under the Act on Prevention of Unjustifiable Premiums and Misleading Representations, the city can issue removal requests to platforms and alert local media. A telephone hotline (☎ 045-845-6666) is available for scam reports.
laws.penalty: Civil and criminal penalties for perpetrators under fraud provisions and the Premiums Act
exceptions: Legitimate promotions with clearly disclosed terms are not subject to removal requests

quiz.q: What does Yokohama City Consumer Affairs Centre do about online scam advertisements?
options: Issues removal requests to platforms and alerts media
Forwards all cases to national police
quiz.explanation: Yokohama's Consumer Affairs Centre issues platform removal requests and alerts local media about scam ads.

laws.title: Kanagawa Liquefaction Risk Zone Disclosure
laws.subtitle: Property sellers must disclose liquefaction risk for reclaimed land
laws.fullDescription: Large parts of Yokohama Port island and Kawasaki's reclaimed industrial zones are prone to liquefaction during earthquakes. Under Kanagawa's real estate disclosure guidelines, sellers must disclose whether a property is in a prefecture-designated liquefaction risk zone. Failure to disclose can result in contract rescission.
laws.penalty: Contract rescission; civil damages; real estate agent licence suspension for non-disclosure
exceptions: Properties on bedrock or in low-risk zones may use simplified disclosure forms

quiz.q: What must Kanagawa real estate sellers disclose about reclaimed land areas?
quiz.explanation: Sellers must disclose if a property is in a prefecture-designated liquefaction risk zone.

laws.title: Yokohama Creative Industry Support Programme
laws.subtitle: City subsidises creative businesses and enforces fair IP practices
laws.fullDescription: Yokohama's Creative City Policy supports artists and cultural entrepreneurs in Koganecho and Kogane-cho art districts. Businesses receiving city cultural subsidies must comply with IP ownership disclosures. Freelancers under the 2024 Freelance Protection Act must receive written contracts.
laws.penalty: Subsidy clawback for non-disclosure; civil action available for uncontracted freelancers
exceptions: Artists displaying at public exhibitions under city patronage have simplified administrative requirements

quiz.q: What are the notable art districts in Yokohama's Creative City programme?
quiz.explanation: Yokohama's Creative City programme is centred on the Koganecho and Kogane-cho art districts.

laws.title: Kanagawa Dog and Dangerous Animal Regulations
laws.subtitle: All dogs must be registered; large breed rules apply
laws.fullDescription: Under Kanagawa's Animal Protection Ordinance and the Rabies Prevention Act, all dogs must be registered annually and vaccinated against rabies. Dogs over 25kg of classified powerful breeds must be kept on lead and muzzled in public. Animal abandonment is a criminal offence.
laws.penalty: Up to ¥1,000,000 fine or 1 year imprisonment for animal abandonment; ¥20,000 for failing to register
exceptions: Working dogs (guide dogs, police dogs, customs detection dogs) are exempt from muzzle requirements

quiz.q: What must dogs over 25kg of specified breeds do in public in Kanagawa?
quiz.explanation: Dogs over 25kg of powerful breeds must be kept on lead and muzzled in public spaces in Kanagawa.

laws.title: Kanagawa Hometown Tax (Furusato Nozei) Rules
laws.subtitle: Donors to Kanagawa municipalities receive tax deductions and local gifts
laws.fullDescription: Under the Hometown Tax system, individuals may donate to Kanagawa municipalities and receive up to 30% of the donation back as gifts of local products. Yokohama City, Kawasaki, and Kamakura participate. Gifts are capped at 30% of donation value and must be locally produced under 2023 rules.
laws.penalty: Municipalities offering non-compliant gifts lose central government equalisation grants
exceptions: Donations over ¥1,000,000 to a single municipality trigger enhanced anti-abuse reporting
laws.sourceLabel: Ministry of Internal Affairs — Furusato Nozei

quiz.q: What is the maximum gift value as a percentage of donation under Japan's Hometown Tax rules?
quiz.explanation: Return gifts are capped at 30% of the donation value under furusato nozei rules.

laws.title: Hakone Ropeway Safety and Capacity Rules
laws.subtitle: Hakone's famous aerial ropeway has strict load and weather rules
laws.fullDescription: The Hakone Ropeway, operating over volcanic terrain, is governed by the Railway Business Act and Cableway Safety Regulations. Each gondola is limited to 18 passengers, and operations are suspended when wind speeds exceed 10 m/s. During volcanic Activity Level 2 or above around Owakudani, the section over the active zone is closed.
laws.penalty: Operator licence suspension for overloading gondolas or operating in unsafe weather
exceptions: Maintenance and safety inspection vehicles may operate outside normal passenger rules

quiz.q: At what wind speed is the Hakone Ropeway suspended?
quiz.explanation: The Hakone Ropeway suspends operations when wind speeds exceed 10 m/s.

laws.title: Kanagawa Urban Tree Canopy Preservation
laws.subtitle: Large trees in designated areas require permit before removal
laws.fullDescription: Kanagawa's Green Area Conservation Ordinance and Yokohama City's Urban Greenery Plan designate large trees as protected green areas. Removal of trees with a trunk circumference of 100cm or more requires advance notification or formal permit from the mayor. The city pays compensation to landowners whose trees are designated 'noteworthy trees'.
laws.penalty: Fines up to ¥3,000,000 for illegal removal of protected trees
exceptions: Dead or diseased trees posing safety hazards may be removed with 24-hour emergency notification

quiz.q: What trunk circumference triggers the permit requirement before tree removal in Yokohama?
quiz.explanation: Trees with a trunk circumference of 100cm or more require advance notification or permit before removal.

laws.title: Kanagawa School Dental Health Programme
laws.subtitle: Annual dental checks are mandatory for all public school students
laws.fullDescription: Under the School Health and Safety Act, all Kanagawa public school students must receive an annual dental examination. Results are recorded and sent to parents. Kanagawa's programme subsidises fluoride treatment and dental sealants for elementary students. Schools must ensure students with dental conditions are referred for treatment within 3 months.
laws.penalty: Administrative guidance for schools failing to conduct annual dental examinations
exceptions: Home-schooled children are exempt from school dental checks

quiz.q: How often are dental examinations mandatory for Kanagawa public school students?
quiz.explanation: Annual dental examinations are mandatory for all public school students in Kanagawa.

laws.title: Kanagawa Vacant Building Safety Ordinance
laws.subtitle: Abandoned buildings can be demolished at owner cost if dangerous
laws.fullDescription: Under the Act on Special Measures for Promotion of Vacant House Measures and Kanagawa's implementing ordinance, authorities can designate abandoned buildings as 'specified vacant houses' if they pose collapse, fire, or hygiene risks. Owners receive improvement orders and, if ignored, the city may demolish the building and bill the owner.
laws.penalty: Forced demolition with costs charged to owner; property tax rebates revoked for vacant structures
exceptions: Historically significant vacant buildings can be placed in a preservation programme instead of demolition

quiz.q: What can Kanagawa authorities do with buildings designated as 'specified vacant houses'?
options: Demolish them and bill the owner
quiz.explanation: After improvement notices are ignored, Kanagawa can demolish 'specified vacant houses' and charge the cost to the owner.

laws.title: Yokohama CCTV Notification Rules
laws.subtitle: CCTV operators must post visible notices to residents
laws.fullDescription: Yokohama City's CCTV guidelines require operators to post clear signage in Japanese and English informing passersby they are being filmed. Footage must be stored securely and deleted within 30 days unless needed for law enforcement. Breach may lead to civil liability for privacy violations.
laws.penalty: Civil liability for privacy invasion; potential Personal Information Protection Act violations
exceptions: Police-operated cameras under investigation orders have separate operational rules

quiz.q: How long must CCTV footage be retained before deletion under Yokohama guidelines?
quiz.explanation: Yokohama's CCTV guidelines require footage to be deleted within 30 days unless needed for law enforcement.

laws.title: Yokohama Port Opening Heritage Commemorations
laws.subtitle: Landmarks from Japan's 1859 port opening are legally protected
laws.fullDescription: Yokohama was opened to foreign trade in 1859 under the Harris Treaty. Several Meiji-era foreign settlement buildings are designated Important Cultural Properties (重要文化財). The Kanagawa Prefectural Museum of Cultural History and Yokohama Archives of History are mandated to maintain public access to the historical record.
laws.penalty: Fines for damaging or altering designated Important Cultural Properties without authorisation
exceptions: Minor restoration work approved by the Agency for Cultural Affairs is permitted
laws.sourceLabel: Kanagawa Prefectural Museum of Cultural History

quiz.q: In which year was Yokohama opened to foreign trade?
quiz.explanation: Yokohama was opened to foreign trade in 1859 under the Harris Treaty.

laws.title: Yokohama Chinatown Monthly Food Inspections
laws.subtitle: Kanagawa health authorities conduct monthly food inspections
laws.fullDescription: Yokohama's Chinatown, with over 600 food businesses, is subject to monthly health inspections by the Yokohama City Health and Environment Research Institute. Restaurants must display current health inspection certificates at the entrance. Serious violations require temporary closure notices displayed at the entrance.
laws.penalty: Temporary closure (営業停止) for serious violations; public display of violation notice required
exceptions: Food market wholesalers with separate wholesale licences are inspected at different intervals
laws.sourceLabel: Yokohama City Health and Environment Research Institute

quiz.q: What must Yokohama Chinatown restaurants display at their entrances?
quiz.explanation: Yokohama Chinatown restaurants must display current health inspection certificates at their entrances.

laws.title: Kanagawa Child Welfare Intervention Rules
laws.subtitle: Child welfare officers have broad powers to investigate suspected abuse
laws.fullDescription: Kanagawa's Child Welfare Centers operate under the Child Welfare Act and the Act on Prevention of Child Abuse. Child welfare officers may conduct welfare checks without parental consent and, in emergencies, remove children to temporary protective care without a court order. Kanagawa tripled its welfare officer numbers since 2018 following nationally publicised child abuse cases.
laws.penalty: Criminal prosecution for obstruction of welfare officers; prison for child abuse perpetrators
exceptions: Physical punishment prohibited since 2020 amendment; traditional discipline reviewed case-by-case

quiz.q: What powers do Kanagawa child welfare officers have in abuse cases?
options: They must get police approval first
They may conduct checks and remove children without court order in emergencies
They require parental consent for all visits
quiz.explanation: Kanagawa child welfare officers may conduct welfare checks without parental consent and remove children without a court order in emergencies.

laws.title: Yokohama Port Longshoremen Licencing
laws.subtitle: Crane operators and dockworkers require certified licences
laws.fullDescription: Port workers at Yokohama engaged in crane operation and hazardous goods loading must hold certificates under the Industrial Safety and Health Act. The Kanagawa Labour Bureau issues crane operation certificates (クレーン運転士). Employers must ensure all listed equipment is operated only by licensed personnel.
laws.penalty: Work suspension; fines up to ¥500,000 for employers allowing unlicensed crane operation; criminal liability for injuries
exceptions: Trainee operators may practice under direct, licensed supervision in designated training zones

quiz.q: What licence is required for crane operators at Yokohama Port?
options: クレーン運転士 (Crane Operator Certificate)
quiz.explanation: Crane operators at Yokohama Port must hold a クレーン運転士 (Crane Operator Certificate) from Kanagawa Labour Bureau.

laws.title: Private Railway Punctuality and Accessibility Rules
laws.subtitle: Tokyu, Keikyu, and Odakyu railways must comply with passenger quality standards
laws.fullDescription: Private railways Tokyu, Keikyu, Odakyu, and Enoshima Electric Railway in Kanagawa must comply with MLIT passenger service quality standards. This includes punctuality targets (within 1 minute), barrier-free access improvements by 2025, and priority boarding assistance for disabled passengers at major stations.
laws.penalty: MLIT business improvement orders; licence conditions may be tightened for persistent failures
exceptions: Delays caused by natural disasters, suicides, or trespassing are excluded from punctuality statistics
laws.sourceLabel: Ministry of Land, Infrastructure, Transport and Tourism

quiz.q: What is Japan's punctuality target for private railways in Kanagawa?
quiz.explanation: Japan's railway system targets punctuality within 1 minute.

laws.title: Kanagawa Refugee Support Programmes
laws.subtitle: Prefecture provides Japanese language and resettlement support for refugees
laws.fullDescription: Kanagawa operates refugee support services through the Japan International Cooperation Agency (JICA) and Kanagawa Foundation for International Exchange (KFIE), providing Japanese language classes, employment counselling, and housing navigation for recognised refugees. Kanagawa has accepted Indochinese refugee families since the late 1970s.
laws.penalty: No prefecture-specific penalties; national immigration law applies for status violations
exceptions: Recognised refugees may apply for permanent residence after 5 years

quiz.q: When did Kanagawa begin accepting Indochinese refugee families?
quiz.explanation: Kanagawa has accepted Indochinese refugee families since the late 1970s.

laws.title: Firearms Prohibition — Kanagawa Enforcement
laws.subtitle: Japan's near-total civilian gun ban is strictly enforced
laws.fullDescription: Japan's Firearms and Swords Control Law prohibits civilian possession of firearms except for licensed hunting and target shooting. Kanagawa Police operate dedicated firearms enforcement units and conduct periodic compliance checks. Yokohama Port is monitored for illegal gun imports. Penalties for illegal possession were enhanced in 2023.
laws.penalty: Up to 15 years imprisonment for illegal firearm possession; up to 3 years for illegal ammunition possession (2023 enhanced penalties)
exceptions: Licensed hunters, competitive shooters, and security professionals with ministry approval may possess firearms under strict conditions

quiz.q: What is the maximum sentence for illegal firearm possession in Japan following 2023 enhancements?
quiz.explanation: Following 2023 enhancements, illegal firearm possession in Japan carries up to 15 years imprisonment.

laws.title: Kanagawa Food Poisoning Reporting Obligation
laws.subtitle: Suspected food poisoning must be reported immediately to health authorities
laws.fullDescription: Under the Food Sanitation Act, medical professionals in Kanagawa who diagnose suspected food poisoning must report it to the nearest Health Centre within 24 hours. Restaurants and food businesses that learn of multiple sick customers must proactively report. The Kanagawa Prefecture Centre for Food Safety investigates all clusters and can issue immediate recalls.
laws.penalty: Fines up to ¥300,000 for medical professionals who fail to report; civil liability for businesses that suppress reports
exceptions: Individual family cases not linked to commercial food are not subject to business reporting rules

quiz.q: Within how many hours must food poisoning be reported to Kanagawa health authorities?
quiz.explanation: Suspected food poisoning must be reported to Kanagawa Prefecture Health Centres within 24 hours.

laws.title: Kamakura Cherry Blossom Crowd Control
laws.subtitle: Seasonal traffic and pedestrian restrictions protect narrow historic streets
laws.fullDescription: During cherry blossom season (late March to early April), Kamakura City implements pedestrian-only closures on Komachi-dori. Private vehicles are prohibited from entering the central shrine area on weekends. Free buses from Kamakura Station to Hase Temple operate during peak periods to manage tourist flow.
laws.penalty: Fines ¥5,000–¥30,000 for driving into pedestrian-only zones during closure periods
exceptions: Residents with vehicle access permits and delivery vehicles in designated windows are exempt

quiz.q: What seasonal measure does Kamakura implement on Komachi-dori during cherry blossom season?
quiz.explanation: Kamakura implements pedestrian-only road closures on Komachi-dori during cherry blossom season.

laws.title: Shonan Citrus and Persimmon Harvest Regulations
laws.subtitle: Kanagawa's coastal farms must follow JAS standards for fruit marketing
laws.fullDescription: The Shonan coastline is known for citrus (mikan) and persimmon cultivation. Under the JAS Act, growers marketing fruit with specific quality grades must meet standards for size, brix (sweetness), and surface appearance. Cooperative members who mislabel grade receive suspension from the co-operative.
laws.penalty: Fines under the JAS Act for misleading labelling; suspension from co-operative marketing programme
exceptions: Seconds fruit sold directly from farm stands may use 'non-graded' labelling

quiz.q: What is the sweetness measurement used in fruit grading?
quiz.explanation: Brix is the measurement of sugar content used in fruit grading, including for Shonan citrus and persimmons.

laws.title: Kawasaki Frontier Research Town Fiscal Incentives
laws.subtitle: R&D firms in Kawasaki's tech cluster receive city tax incentives
laws.fullDescription: Kawasaki City's Frontier Research Town around Shin-Kawasaki station offers corporate tax reductions and land-use fee subsidies to qualifying research institutions and biotech companies. Firms must be engaged in approved R&D activities, maintain a minimum of 20 researchers, and file annual activity reports.
laws.penalty: Clawback of all received incentives plus interest for misrepresentation or early discontinuation of qualifying activities
exceptions: Startups in their first 3 years have simplified filing requirements

quiz.q: Where is Kawasaki's Frontier Research Town located?
quiz.explanation: Kawasaki's Frontier Research Town is centred around Shin-Kawasaki Station.

laws.title: Yokohama Port Festival Permit Requirements
laws.subtitle: Events in Yamashita Park require city approval
laws.fullDescription: Yamashita Park hosts the Port Festival (港まつり) every May and other major outdoor events. Organisers of events over 1,000 attendees must apply for a park use permit at least 45 days in advance, specifying allowed areas, waste management, sound levels, and fire safety requirements.
laws.penalty: Event termination and fines up to ¥300,000 for unpermitted events over 1,000 people
exceptions: Small spontaneous gatherings under 50 persons do not require advance permits

quiz.q: How many days in advance must large event permits be applied for at Yamashita Park?
quiz.explanation: Events over 1,000 attendees at Yamashita Park require permit applications at least 45 days in advance.

laws.title: Kanagawa Ocean Plastic Reduction Programme
laws.subtitle: Businesses near the coast face enhanced plastic waste rules
laws.fullDescription: Under Kanagawa's Marine Litter Countermeasures Plan, businesses within 2km of Kanagawa's coastline must conduct annual plastic waste audits and implement reduction plans. Retail businesses must comply with plastic bag reduction requirements and may not distribute non-biodegradable straws as standard.
laws.penalty: Warning, then fines up to ¥500,000 for businesses failing to comply
exceptions: Medical facilities may use non-biodegradable plastic for hygiene-critical applications

quiz.q: What distance from the coast triggers Kanagawa's enhanced plastic waste rules for businesses?
quiz.explanation: Businesses within 2km of Kanagawa's coastline face enhanced plastic waste audit and reduction plan requirements.

laws.title: Kanagawa Biobank Consent and Privacy Rules
laws.subtitle: Genetic research requires strict informed consent under prefecture guidelines
laws.fullDescription: Kanagawa's concentration of biotech and pharmaceutical firms has led to detailed Biobank Ethical Guidelines implementing national law. Patients contributing samples must give specific written consent; blanket consent is insufficient for secondary uses. Genetic data may not be used for insurance assessment without express separate consent.
laws.penalty: Research programme suspension by ethics committee; prosecution under Personal Information Protection Act for genetic data misuse
exceptions: Anonymised aggregate research data not linked to individuals is exempt from individual consent requirements

quiz.q: What type of consent is required for genetic data use in insurance assessment in Kanagawa?
options: Express separate consent specifically for insurance
quiz.explanation: Genetic data may not be used for insurance assessment without express, specific separate consent.

laws.title: Guide Dog Access Rights in Kanagawa
laws.subtitle: Service animals must be admitted to all public places and transport
laws.fullDescription: Under the Acts for Supporting the Independence of Persons with Disabilities and for Eliminating Discrimination, certified guide dogs (盲導犬), hearing dogs (聴導犬), and service dogs (介助犬) must be admitted to all public facilities, restaurants, hotels, and public transport in Kanagawa. Refusal must be justified on specific safety grounds.
laws.penalty: Administrative guidance; civil liability for service providers who unjustifiably refuse service animal access
exceptions: Operating kitchens and sterile medical environments may exclude service animals with reasonable accommodation offered

quiz.q: Which three types of service animals must be admitted to public places in Kanagawa?
options: Guard dogs, detection dogs, therapy dogs
Guide dogs, hearing dogs, service dogs
Police dogs, bomb dogs, drug dogs
Show dogs, racing greyhounds, sled dogs
quiz.explanation: Certified guide dogs (盲導犬), hearing dogs (聴導犬), and service dogs (介助犬) must be admitted to all public facilities.

laws.title: Yokohama Minato Mirai Smart Building Standards
laws.subtitle: New developments must include energy and IoT infrastructure
laws.fullDescription: New buildings of 2,000 sqm or more in the Minato Mirai zone must install BEMS (Building Energy Management Systems), energy-efficient LED lighting, and EV charging points covering at least 20% of parking spaces. Buildings receiving city incentives must publish annual energy performance reports. Yokohama aims for carbon neutrality by 2030.
laws.penalty: Loss of city development incentives; building permit conditions for non-compliant designs
exceptions: Heritage buildings converted to new uses may apply for modified smart building requirements

quiz.q: What minimum percentage of parking spaces must have EV charging in new Minato Mirai buildings?
quiz.explanation: New buildings of 2,000 sqm or more in Minato Mirai must provide EV charging for at least 20% of parking spaces.

laws.title: Kanagawa Used Vehicle Dealer Disclosure Rules
laws.subtitle: Used car dealers must fully disclose accident history
laws.fullDescription: Kanagawa's used vehicle dealers under the Act on Specified Commercial Transactions and Used Goods Dealer Licencing must disclose accident history, flood damage (significant after typhoon seasons), and odometer discrepancies. Deliberate concealment of significant damage history is prosecuted as fraud.
laws.penalty: Up to 10 years imprisonment and ¥5,000,000 fine for odometer tampering fraud; contract rescission for non-disclosure
exceptions: Auction houses selling vehicles as-is with documented inspection reports are exempt from dealer warranty obligations
laws.sourceLabel: Kanagawa Prefecture Used Goods Dealer Regulation

quiz.q: What specific damage type must Kanagawa used vehicle dealers disclose after typhoons?
quiz.explanation: Flood damage must be fully disclosed by Kanagawa used vehicle dealers, particularly after typhoon seasons.

laws.title: Kanagawa Workplace Stress Check Obligation
laws.subtitle: Employers must conduct annual stress checks for all employees
laws.fullDescription: Under the Industrial Safety and Health Act as amended in 2015, all employers with 50 or more employees in Kanagawa must conduct annual stress check tests. Individual results are confidential; only aggregate data is shared with employers. Workers who score high-stress may request a medical interview that employers cannot refuse.
laws.penalty: Fines up to ¥500,000 for employers failing to conduct stress checks; penalties for breaching medical interview confidentiality
exceptions: Companies under 50 employees have a voluntary system

quiz.q: When was Japan's mandatory workplace stress check law introduced?
quiz.explanation: The mandatory annual workplace stress check was introduced in the 2015 amendment to the Industrial Safety and Health Act.

laws.title: Yokohama Western-Style Architecture Preservation
laws.subtitle: Meiji-era buildings in Yamate are protected as historical assets
laws.fullDescription: Yokohama's Yamate (山手) hillside district contains some of Japan's finest surviving Western-style residences from the Meiji and Taisho eras. These are designated Historic Buildings by Yokohama City. Owners must consult with the city before any exterior alterations and must maintain the distinctive Western architectural character.
laws.penalty: Fines up to ¥500,000 for unauthorised exterior alterations to designated historic buildings
exceptions: Interior modifications not affecting historic facade characteristics may proceed with notification only

quiz.q: In which Yokohama district are the most significant Western-style Meiji-era buildings found?
quiz.explanation: The Yamate hillside district of Yokohama contains Japan's finest surviving Western-style residences from the Meiji and Taisho eras.

laws.title: Yokohama Fire Prevention — High-Rise Buildings
laws.subtitle: Stringent fire escape and suppression rules for tall buildings
laws.fullDescription: Buildings over 60 metres in Yokohama must have automatic sprinkler systems covering all floors, pressurised stairwell smoke extraction, refuge floors (避難階) at set intervals, and 30-minute fire-rated structural elements. Annual fire drills are mandatory and must include evacuation of mobility-impaired occupants.
laws.penalty: Fines up to ¥3,000,000; building use restriction orders for serious fire safety deficiencies
exceptions: Pre-existing buildings may qualify for phased compliance with approved retrofit schedules

quiz.q: What height threshold triggers Yokohama's enhanced high-rise fire prevention rules?
quiz.explanation: Buildings over 60 metres in Yokohama face enhanced fire prevention requirements.

laws.title: Kanagawa Bicycle Parking Rules at Stations
laws.subtitle: Illegally parked bicycles are removed and impounded
laws.fullDescription: Under the Act on Promotion of Bicycle Utilization, municipalities actively remove bicycles parked outside designated cycle parking areas near railway stations. Impoundment fees range from ¥1,000 to ¥2,500 for first removal, with higher charges for repeat offences. Yokohama has invested in major underground cycle parking facilities at key stations.
laws.penalty: Impoundment fees ¥1,000–¥2,500; escalating fees for repeat offenders
exceptions: Bicycles with disabled parking permits may use expanded areas near station entrances

quiz.q: What type of bicycle parking facility has Yokohama invested in near major stations?
quiz.explanation: Yokohama has invested in underground cycle parking facilities at key stations.

laws.title: Yokohama Craft Beer Brewpub Licensing
laws.subtitle: Microbreweries with on-site consumption require dual licences
laws.fullDescription: Kanagawa's craft beer scene operates under the Liquor Tax Act and Food Sanitation Act. A microbrewery must hold both a sake manufacturing licence issued by the Yokohama Tax Office and a restaurant licence for on-premises consumption. Annual minimum production quotas (60 kilolitres for beer) apply; the 2018 special small brewery designation helps smaller operations.
laws.penalty: Licence revocation for producing alcohol without a manufacturing licence; fines for on-premises sales without food licence
exceptions: Homebrew for personal non-commercial consumption is legal in Japan

quiz.q: What annual minimum production did the 2018 small brewery designation help Kanagawa breweries below?
quiz.explanation: The 2018 special small brewery designation helped microbreweries unable to meet the standard 60 kilolitre annual minimum.

laws.title: Kawasaki Industrial Hazardous Waste Disposal
laws.subtitle: Strict manifest system governs industrial toxic waste
laws.fullDescription: Kawasaki City, with one of Japan's densest concentrations of chemical, steel, and energy industries, enforces rigorous industrial waste manifest (マニフェスト) requirements. Every transfer of industrial waste must be accompanied by a 6-copy manifest tracking it from generator to final disposal. Electronic manifests have been mandatory for most industrial waste since 2020.
laws.penalty: Up to ¥3,000,000 fine or 1 year imprisonment for manifest falsification; up to ¥10,000,000 and 5 years for illegal dumping
exceptions: Very small generators under 10kg per day of specific non-toxic waste may use simplified records

quiz.q: How many copies must an industrial waste manifest have in Kawasaki?
quiz.explanation: Industrial waste transfers in Kawasaki must be accompanied by a 6-copy manifest.

laws.title: Kanagawa Information Disclosure Ordinance
laws.subtitle: Residents can request prefecture documents under transparency rules
laws.fullDescription: Kanagawa's Information Disclosure Ordinance grants all residents and entities the right to request prefecture administrative documents unless they fall within defined exemptions. Requests must receive a response within 14 days. Appeal of non-disclosure decisions goes to the Kanagawa Information Disclosure Review Board.
laws.penalty: No criminal penalty; non-compliance with the Review Board's ruling may trigger prefectural ombudsman investigation
exceptions: Documents relating to ongoing investigations, national security, or individual privacy are exempt

quiz.q: Within how many days must Kanagawa Prefecture respond to an information disclosure request?
quiz.explanation: Kanagawa Prefecture must respond to information disclosure requests within 14 days.

laws.title: Yokohama Red Brick Warehouse Event Rules
laws.subtitle: Historic port warehouse converted to cultural venue has strict event guidelines
laws.fullDescription: Yokohama's Red Brick Warehouse (赤レンガ倉庫), a Meiji-era port facility designated as a Historic Building, hosts major events. Commercial events using the plaza must apply 60 days in advance and maintain a maximum sound level of 85 dB at the building face. The structure's historic masonry must not be permanently affixed without written authorisation.
laws.penalty: Event termination and fines for exceeding sound limits; civil liability for structural damage to the historic building
exceptions: City-organised cultural events on the National Day of Cultural Heritage are exempt from advance application fees

quiz.q: How many days in advance must commercial event applications be submitted for the Red Brick Warehouse plaza?
quiz.explanation: Commercial events at the Red Brick Warehouse plaza require applications 60 days in advance.

laws.title: Kanagawa Cybercrime Reporting and Enforcement
laws.subtitle: Kanagawa Prefectural Police have a dedicated cybercrime division
laws.fullDescription: Kanagawa Prefectural Police's Cybercrime Division handles online fraud, unauthorized computer access, and child exploitation material. In 2019, a Kanagawa government contractor was arrested for stealing and selling personal data of 9 million residents — Japan's largest government data breach — leading to significantly enhanced data security requirements for all prefectural vendors.
laws.penalty: Up to 3 years imprisonment for unauthorized access; up to 5 years for large-scale data theft with intent to sell
exceptions: Security research conducted with explicit written permission from system owners is exempt

quiz.q: What significant data incident in 2019 strengthened Kanagawa's data security rules?
options: Hack of Yokohama City Hall systems
A contractor stealing and selling data of 9 million residents
Ransomware attack on port management systems
quiz.explanation: In 2019, a Kanagawa contractor stole and sold personal data of 9 million residents — Japan's largest government data breach.
